scientific_question: Do ICBHI cycles and SPRSound events benefit from eligibility-masked compatible-label supervision while all four datasets retain native heads?

fixed_native_surface.condition: D2 shared 768->256 adapter plus six dataset-native heads
fixed_native_surface.folds: five KAUH-fold-conditioned models; KAUH patient OOF
fixed_native_surface.test_policy: outer/test used only after validation selection; SPR inter predictions are label-free before terminal annotation join

binary.sprsound: official Normal vs all Adventitious event binary

narrow4.sprsound: Normal; Coarse/Fine Crackle->crackle; Wheeze; Wheeze+Crackle; Rhonchi/Stridor/Poor Quality ineligible

compatible_tasks.missing_label_policy: ineligible or missing targets create no loss and are never negative

h0_native_plus_independent_compatible.compatible_heads: full 256-d separate ICBHI and SPR heads

h1_eligibility_masked_shared.compatible_heads: one shared binary and one shared narrow4 head with per-output trainable scales

h2_parameter_matched_independent.compatible_heads: separate ICBHI and SPR heads after fixed seed-20260728 orthonormal 256->128 projections
h2_parameter_matched_independent.caveat: fixed projection equalizes trainable parameters but reduces compatible-head input dimension

loss_and_selection.batch_loss: unweighted mean of active native and compatible CE/BCE losses; inactive routes are omitted
loss_and_selection.selection: unweighted mean validation macro-F1 across six native tasks plus ICBHI/SPR binary and narrow4 compatible tasks
loss_and_selection.forbidden: outer/test condition, epoch, threshold, mapping, or loss-weight selection

preregistered_go_rule.comparison: H1 shared minus H2 parameter-matched independent
preregistered_go_rule.primary_binary: each dataset macro-F1 and UAR gap >=-0.02; worst-dataset macro-F1 and UAR gap >=-0.02; at least one of the four dataset-metric pairs improves >=0.02
preregistered_go_rule.collapse_guard: each dataset normal specificity gap >=-0.05 and predicted abnormal prevalence remains in [0.02,0.98]
preregistered_go_rule.native_side_effect: at most one of six native tasks may lose >0.02 macro-F1 and no native task may lose >0.05
preregistered_go_rule.decision: support Representation Harmonization only if every primary, collapse, and native-side-effect gate passes
preregistered_go_rule.narrow4: diagnostic only and never used for the go decision

claim_boundary: HF tasks are positive-presence diagnostics with missing labels omitted
KAUH is sparse five-fold patient OOF
no full encoder, router, MoE, loss sweep, or threshold tuning
